channel.title: GNUS digest
channel.description: Daily digest of the GeniusVentures GitHub activity, written from public commit messages.

item.title: GNUS digest — Tuesday 24 November
item.description: Several fixes and upgrades were applied to the network dispatch system, and documentation was updated for runner settings. The SDK’s generated models were refreshed, and a new architecture‑review capability was added to the cognitive system. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, SuperGenius, GeniusCognitiveSystem, openapi-cpp-scaffolding, thirdparty, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Monday 23 November
item.description: The network component addressed iOS archive problems and updated dispatch triage, while related fixes were made in another blockchain repository. A test fix was merged for the cognitive system. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, SuperGenius, GeniusCognitiveSystem, rlp_enodes, openapi-client-scaffold.

item.title: GNUS digest — Sunday 22 November
item.description: The wallet resolved a frozen initialization feed and improved rename handling, adding new tests and configuration changes. The blockchain network cleaned up records, applied an upgrade and added test scenarios. Repositories: GeniusWallet, SuperGenius.

item.title: GNUS digest — Saturday 21 November
item.description: New support for recovering canonical nonce certificates and fixing pruned holds was added to the blockchain, accompanied by extensive testing and refactoring. The network updated internal pointers, recorded rulings, and added test and documentation updates. Repositories: SuperGenius, GeniusNetwork.

item.title: GNUS digest — Friday 20 November
item.description: Research questions in the network were marked resolved and test plans were added, with documentation updates. The blockchain introduced a downgrade interlock gate, fixed hold issues, added tests and clarified escrow release documentation. Minor test and review updates were made to the cognitive system and SDK tools. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, SuperGenius, GeniusCognitiveSystem, openapi-cpp-scaffolding, openapi-client-scaffold, GeniusSDK.

item.title: GNUS digest — Thursday 19 November
item.description: Phase research and protocol declarations were added to the network, along with upgrades and test work for human verification. The blockchain added a seal‑growth probe harness and related tests. Documentation was clarified for template forwarding and document hash synchronization. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, SuperGenius, gitbook, documentation, openapi-cpp-scaffolding, openapi-client-scaffold.
